name: Will an after-hours plumber provide a temporary fix or a permanent solution?

mainEntity.name: Will an after-hours plumber provide a temporary fix or a permanent solution?

acceptedAnswer.text: An after-hours plumber typically aims to provide a permanent solution to the immediate plumbing emergency whenever possible. However, if a permanent repair requires specialized parts that are not readily available after hours or extensive work, a temporary fix may be implemented to stop the immediate issue and prevent further damage. In such cases, the technician will discuss options for a follow-up appointment during regular business hours to complete any remaining work. Our priority is to secure your property from immediate harm.
acceptedAnswer.description: After-hours plumbers aim for permanent solutions, but may provide temporary fixes if specialized parts are needed, with follow-up options.
